functions.name: wiliwili::pre0
functions.description: Left-pads the decimal representation of num with '0' characters to achieve at least length characters. If num already has length or more digits, returns the unmodified decimal string. Useful for producing fixed-width numeric fields.
requirements: num and length are size_t (non-negative).
No maximum length specified; callers should ensure length is reasonable to avoid excessive allocations.

functions.name: wiliwili::unix_time
functions.description: Returns the current system time as a Unix time_t (seconds since the Unix epoch) using std::chrono::system_clock::now(). Intended for retrieving the current wall-clock time in seconds.
requirements: No arguments; callable at any time.
Time source is std::chrono::system_clock; behavior depends on system clock availability.

functions.name: wiliwili::getRandomText
functions.description: Generates a random text string of the requested length. Exact character set is not documented in this header; typically implies alphanumeric letters. Use when a random identifier of textual characters is needed.
requirements: length must be >= 0; negative values are invalid/undefined.
Exact character distribution and charset are unspecified in this header.

functions.name: wiliwili::getRandomNumber
functions.description: Generates a random numeric string of the requested length (composed of digits). Useful for codes or numeric tokens.
requirements: length must be >= 0; negative values are invalid/undefined.
Character set expected to be digits 0-9; exact distribution not specified.

functions.name: wiliwili::getRandomHex
functions.signature: std::string wiliwili::getRandomHex(int length, bool lowerCase = true)
functions.description: Generates a random hexadecimal string of the specified length. The lowerCase flag controls letter casing (true for lowercase a-f, false for uppercase A-F).
requirements: length must be >= 0; negative values are invalid/undefined.
Hexadecimal character set is implied; exact distribution not specified.

functions.name: wiliwili::sec2Time
functions.description: Formats a duration t (in seconds) into a zero-padded time string. Examples: 100 -> "01:40" (MM:SS), 4180 -> "01:09:40" (HH:MM:SS). Hours appear when duration >= 3600.
requirements: t is a non-negative duration in seconds (size_t).
Output format: MM:SS for durations < 1 hour; HH:MM:SS for >= 1 hour.

functions.name: wiliwili::uglyString2Time
functions.description: Converts a provider-specific duration string (e.g., from Bilibili) into a more standard zero-padded HH:MM:SS format. Example: "120:12" -> "02:00:12".
requirements: str should represent a duration with components separated by ':' where the first component may exceed 59 (e.g., "MM:SS" with large minutes).
Input must be parseable as non-negative integer components.
Exact accepted patterns beyond the example are not specified.

functions.name: wiliwili::sec2TimeDLNA
functions.description: Formats duration t (seconds) into a DLNA-style time string without zero-padding the hours. Examples: 100 -> "0:01:40", 4180 -> "1:09:40".
requirements: t is a non-negative duration in seconds (size_t).
Output format: H:MM:SS where H is not zero-padded; for durations < 1 hour, H is 0.

functions.name: wiliwili::sec2MinSec
functions.description: Formats duration t (seconds) as M:SS where minutes may exceed 59. Example: 4180 -> "69:40".
requirements: t is a non-negative duration in seconds (size_t).
Output format: M:SS; minutes are not bounded to [0,59].

functions.name: wiliwili::num2w
functions.description: Formats large counts using the Chinese "万" unit when appropriate. Examples: 1102 -> "1102", 11022 -> "1.1万", 10022 -> "1万".
requirements: t is a non-negative count (size_t).
Rounding/precision policy beyond examples is not specified in this header.

functions.name: wiliwili::sec2date
functions.description: Formats a Unix timestamp into a human-friendly relative/absolute date string with Chinese terms: <1min => "刚刚", <1hour => "N分钟前", <1day => "N小时前", <2day => "昨天", within this year => "M-D", otherwise => "YYYY-M-D".
requirements: sec is a Unix timestamp in seconds (time_t).
Output language/locale is Chinese per documented examples.
Behavior depends on current system time and local calendar/clock.

functions.name: wiliwili::sec2dateV2
functions.description: Formats a Unix timestamp as a calendar date string in the form YYYY-MM-DD. Documented as '生成年月日: 2023-01-01'.
requirements: sec is a Unix timestamp in seconds (time_t).
Output format is zero-padded year-month-day: YYYY-MM-DD.

functions.name: wiliwili::sec2FullDate
functions.description: Formats a Unix timestamp into a full date/time string. Exact format is not documented in this header; likely includes both date and time, but details are unknown.
requirements: sec is a Unix timestamp in seconds (time_t).
Exact output format is unspecified in this header; callers should not rely on a specific pattern without checking the implementation.

functions.name: wiliwili::sec2TimeDate
functions.description: Converts a Unix timestamp into a time and date string. The precise formatting is not specified in this header; details are unknown.
requirements: sec is a Unix timestamp in seconds (time_t).
Exact output format is unspecified; verify with implementation if a specific pattern is required.

functions.name: wiliwili::getUnixTime
functions.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp as an unsigned size_t value. Serves as a convenience wrapper for obtaining the current time in seconds.
requirements: No arguments; callable at any time.
Returned value fits in size_t; on some platforms size_t may differ in width from time_t.
